description: Compute the single weighted-average interest rate across a list of loan balances (e.g. multiple credit cards or student loans being weighed for consolidation), weighting each loan's rate by its share of the combined balance, plus the combined monthly and annual interest accrual.

loans.description: A non-empty list of loan balances and rates

ratePercent.description: Annual interest rate for this loan, as a percent

name: calculate_blended_loan_rate
